search.title: Jared Dudley
search.snippet: Jared Anthony Dudley (born July 10, 1985) is an American professional basketball coach and former player who is an assistant coach for the Denver Nuggets

search.title: Jared
search.snippet: Jared is a given name of Biblical derivation. In the Book of Genesis, the biblical patriarch Jared (יֶרֶד) was the sixth in the ten pre-flood generations

search.title: Dudley (surname)
search.snippet: University, Maryland Jared Dudley (born 1985), American basketball player Jimmy Dudley (1909–1999), American sportscaster John Dudley, 1st Duke of Northumberland
